observability_method: Each check reads the live contract table's per-bar SIGNAL_ID/SIGNAL_BAR_TIME/ACTION fields AND the P5 recorder's lifetime P5_TOTAL_SIGNALS counter and P5_LAST_SIGNAL_TIME pointer. The lifetime counter/pointer are 'var' accumulators that update the instant ANY new signal is authorized on ANY bar (confirmed or not) and are never reset by display/history eviction -- they are immune to gaps between manual checks as long as the same indicator instance keeps running without being removed/re-added. This instance (entity TYuV4V) has run continuously since C4 was applied and has not been removed/re-added, so an unchanged P5_TOTAL_SIGNALS and an unchanged, still-pre-boundary P5_LAST_SIGNAL_TIME between two checks is complete, authoritative proof that zero new signals occurred anywhere in the elapsed interval -- not merely on the single bar visible at check time.
